newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico announces $1.5 bln export loan support plan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico announces $1.5 bln export loan support plan.

text.p: Mexico's Foreign Trade Bank (Bancomext) announced a new $1.5 billion business loan guarantee program on Thursday.

"We're talking about a $1.5 billion program," Bancomext director Enrique Vilatela Riba told journalists, "whereby Bancomext will absorb 70 percent of the risk entailed in Mexican commercial banks' support to exporting companies."
Vilatela, here at the Fourth National Foreign Trade Congress, said the program was designed to keep exports as the driving force behind the Mexican economy.
He did not have details as to how many companies the program would benefit, but added there was an upper limit of $20 million per company.
Seven commercial banks had confirmed their participation in the program, he added.
